scope: Bounded large-data replication of resource-aware RGB VQA selectors; no codec/VLM training, SNR sweep or manuscript edits

data.selection: Deterministic seeded image-disjoint allocation; single agreed normalized answer; no model output or correctness used for selection
data.exclusions: All enumerable historical manifests/audits, receiver LoRA training, EXP012/013 images, legacy development and old sealed test300 image IDs
data.test_truth: Data preparer writes test_truth.sealed.json once; training and inference do not load it. Test scoring only after controller and all comparisons freeze.
data.test_images: Download and featurize new test only after controller freeze; old sealed300 images/truth remain untouched.
data.shortfall: Fail with counts, never silently duplicate images, change quotas or omit a category.
data.source_change: Old pilot training used val2014. New train2014 source prevents interpreting old-vs-new as a pure sample-size effect; nested480 uses the same new source and validation set.

receiver: Frozen Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct NF4 plus standard language rank8 LoRA
codec: Frozen bmshj2018-hyperprior quality3, longedge320, uniform level8 map, 12-step global gain search, packet-only RGB roundtrip

features.image_scaler: fit on each arm training subset only

loss.absolute: BCEWithLogits per candidate correctness; minimum validation BCE checkpoint
loss.gain: tanh(z_a-z_ref), signed correct_a-correct_ref; MSE over nonreference heads; minimum validation gain MSE checkpoint
loss.reference: Lowest nominal-cost action within the family; gain ref is exactly zero; preserve negative harm
loss.weighting: No correctness-driven oversampling or class weighting; all training images retained

selection.decision: Absolute probability minus lambda*cost, or signed gain minus lambda*(cost-cost_ref)
selection.action_ties: Lower nominal cost then lower action index
selection.ensemble: Arithmetic mean of three seed outputs before choosing action
selection.candidate_ties: Maximum validation realized utility, then lower mean nominal cost of selected actions, then lexicographic recipe/family name
selection.primary_joint: Choose one LARGE joint ensemble from the four recipes using validation utility only
selection.strong_rate: Choose one LARGE rate ensemble across all four recipes and three rate families using validation utility only
selection.strong_compute: Choose one LARGE compute ensemble across all four recipes and three compute families using validation utility only
selection.strong_fixed: Choose one fixed action among all nine using validation utility, then lower nominal cost/action index
selection.nested: Train all four joint recipes on deterministic80/type subset of the new train source. Secondary sample-size control only; never choose main method from nested fits.

screen.full_cost_gate: PENDING until live end-to-end latency/energy is measured
screen.scope: Exploratory point-estimate screen, not a statistical noninferiority guarantee

test.freeze_before_test: All96 checkpoints, scalers, dataset manifests, protocol, validation predictions, main recipe, fixed/axis controls and evaluation code hashes
test.execution: One frozen test evaluation regardless of development screen; no retuning, no selection of a test winner
primary_comparisons: selected joint vs selected strong_fixed utility
selected joint vs selected strong_rate utility
selected joint vs selected strong_compute utility
test.inference: Paired image bootstrap2000, seed20260923; two-sided image signflip10000 for three primary utility contrasts against zero, Holm family3. Significance against zero does not establish a gain exceeding0.005.
test.accuracy: Report paired difference and unadjusted95% CI vs fixed4000_medium and all three strong controls; no claim of proven noninferiority solely from the point screen
test.secondary: All four large joints, all four nested joints, all seeds, common mixed-image AUC, rescue/harm, per-type results; descriptive only, never replace frozen primary
test.power_caveat: 2400 paired images improves precision but does not guarantee resolving1pp differences or the0.833pp noninferiority margin

resources.resume: Immutable fingerprints, reuse verified complete per-image journals; no new fitting budget on resume

limitations: Question downlink is not newly optimized in this phase; keep one-byte framing visible.
Public-data holdout excludes enumerable project exposure, not foundation-model pretraining.
Target intervention combines output parameterization, objective and checkpoint criterion.

Source split differs from pilot; nested480 is a same-source fixed-training-recipe scale comparison, not an isolated sample-count causal effect: scalers differ and each epoch has15 versus150 optimizer steps.
